# University of Malaga

A public university located in [[Málaga]], Spain. It offers the B.Sc. in Software Engineering program attended by [[Álvaro Jiménez Martínez]] from September 2022 to June 2026, graduating with a GPA of 8.6/10 (top 10% of class). The program includes coursework in Computer Vision, Deep Learning, Distributed Systems, Cloud Computing, and Software Architecture. Álvaro's bachelor's thesis, titled *Semantic 3D Reconstruction of Agricultural Farms*, earned a grade of 10/10 with honors and applied [[3D Gaussian Splatting]] combined with Vision-Language Models.
